<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Coin Hopper</title>
<style>body{margin:0;background:#111;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;height:100vh}</style>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@3.80.1/dist/phaser.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
<script>
const T = 40;
const LEVELS = [
  [
    "....................",
    "....................",
    "....................",
    "....................",
    "....................",
    "....................",
    "....................",
    "....................",
    "....................",
    "......ccc...........",
    "......###.....ccc...",
    "..............###...",
    ".P..c..E........c.G.",
    "####################",
    "####################",
  ],
  [
    "....................",
    "....................",
    "....................",
    "....................",
    "....................",
    "....................",
    "....................",
    "....................",
    "..........ccc.......",
    "..........###...ccc.",
    "......ccc.......###.",
    "......###...........",
    ".P.c..........E...G.",
    "####...###....######",
    "####...###....######",
  ],
];

class GameScene extends Phaser.Scene {
  constructor() { super('Game'); }
  init(data) { this.level = data.level || 0; this.total = data.total || 0; }
  preload() {
    const g = this.make.graphics({ add: false });
    const tex = (key, w, h, draw) => { g.clear(); draw(g); g.generateTexture(key, w, h); };
    tex('tile', T, T, g => { g.fillStyle(0x6b4a2b).fillRect(0, 0, T, T); g.fillStyle(0x4caf50).fillRect(0, 0, T, 8); g.lineStyle(1, 0x3a2a18).strokeRect(0, 0, T, T); });
    tex('player', 28, 36, g => { g.fillStyle(0x3b82f6).fillRect(0, 0, 28, 36); g.fillStyle(0xffffff).fillRect(16, 8, 8, 8); g.fillStyle(0x000000).fillRect(20, 10, 4, 4); });
    tex('coin', 20, 20, g => { g.fillStyle(0xffd700).fillCircle(10, 10, 9); g.lineStyle(2, 0xb8860b).strokeCircle(10, 10, 9); });
    tex('enemy', 32, 32, g => { g.fillStyle(0xe53935).fillRect(0, 0, 32, 32); g.fillStyle(0xffffff).fillRect(6, 8, 8, 8).fillRect(18, 8, 8, 8); g.fillStyle(0).fillRect(9, 11, 4, 4).fillRect(21, 11, 4, 4); });
    tex('goal', 20, 40, g => { g.fillStyle(0xdddddd).fillRect(0, 0, 4, 40); g.fillStyle(0x00e676).fillTriangle(4, 2, 20, 10, 4, 18); });
  }
  create() {
    this.cameras.main.setBackgroundColor('#87ceeb');
    this.physics.world.setBounds(0, 0, 800, 600);
    this.dead = false; this.won = false; this.coins = 0;
    this.tiles = this.physics.add.staticGroup();
    this.coinGroup = this.physics.add.staticGroup();
    this.enemies = this.physics.add.group({ allowGravity: false });
    const map = LEVELS[this.level];
    let spawn = { x: 60, y: 480 };
    map.forEach((row, r) => [...row].forEach((ch, c) => {
      const x = c * T + T / 2, y = r * T + T / 2;
      if (ch === '#') this.tiles.create(x, y, 'tile');
      else if (ch === 'c') this.coinGroup.create(x, y, 'coin');
      else if (ch === 'P') spawn = { x, y };
      else if (ch === 'G') this.goal = this.physics.add.staticImage(x, y, 'goal');
      else if (ch === 'E') {
        const e = this.enemies.create(x, y + 4, 'enemy');
        e.minX = x - 80; e.maxX = x + 80; e.setVelocityX(70);
      }
    }));
    this.player = this.physics.add.sprite(spawn.x, spawn.y, 'player');
    this.player.setCollideWorldBounds(true);
    this.player.body.setMaxVelocityY(800);
    this.player.jumps = 0;
    this.physics.world.setBoundsCollision(true, true, true, false); // allow falling into pits
    this.physics.add.collider(this.player, this.tiles);
    this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.coinGroup, (p, c) => { c.destroy(); this.coins++; this.updateHud(); });
    this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.enemies, (p, e) => {
      if (p.body.velocity.y > 0 && p.body.bottom - e.body.top < 16) { e.destroy(); p.setVelocityY(-380); p.jumps = 1; }
      else this.die();
    });
    this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.goal, () => this.finish());
    this.cursors = this.input.keyboard.createCursorKeys();
    this.keys = this.input.keyboard.addKeys('W,A,D,SPACE');
    this.hud = this.add.text(10, 8, '', { fontSize: '20px', color: '#000', fontStyle: 'bold' }).setDepth(10);
    this.add.text(790, 8, 'Arrows/WASD move · Up/W/Space jump (x2)', { fontSize: '14px', color: '#000' }).setOrigin(1, 0);
    this.updateHud();
  }
  updateHud() { this.hud.setText(`Level ${this.level + 1}/${LEVELS.length}   Coins: ${this.total + this.coins}`); }
  die() {
    if (this.dead) return; this.dead = true;
    this.cameras.main.shake(200, 0.01);
    this.time.delayedCall(350, () => this.scene.restart({ level: this.level, total: this.total }));
  }
  finish() {
    if (this.won) return; this.won = true;
    const total = this.total + this.coins;
    if (this.level + 1 < LEVELS.length) this.scene.restart({ level: this.level + 1, total });
    else this.scene.start('Win', { total });
  }
  update() {
    if (this.dead || this.won) return;
    const p = this.player, c = this.cursors, k = this.keys;
    const left = c.left.isDown || k.A.isDown, right = c.right.isDown || k.D.isDown;
    p.setVelocityX(left ? -210 : right ? 210 : 0);
    if (left) p.setFlipX(true); else if (right) p.setFlipX(false);
    if (p.body.blocked.down) p.jumps = 0;
    const J = Phaser.Input.Keyboard.JustDown;
    if (J(c.up) || J(k.W) || J(k.SPACE)) {
      if (p.body.blocked.down) { p.setVelocityY(-560); p.jumps = 1; }
      else if (p.jumps < 2) { p.setVelocityY(-520); p.jumps = 2; }
    }
    this.enemies.getChildren().forEach(e => {
      if (e.x < e.minX) e.setVelocityX(70); else if (e.x > e.maxX) e.setVelocityX(-70);
    });
    if (p.y > 640) this.die();
  }
}

class WinScene extends Phaser.Scene {
  constructor() { super('Win'); }
  init(d) { this.total = d.total; }
  create() {
    this.cameras.main.setBackgroundColor('#1b5e20');
    this.add.text(400, 220, 'YOU WIN!', { fontSize: '72px', color: '#ffd700', fontStyle: 'bold' }).setOrigin(0.5);
    this.add.text(400, 310, `Coins collected: ${this.total}`, { fontSize: '32px', color: '#fff' }).setOrigin(0.5);
    this.add.text(400, 400, 'Press SPACE to play again', { fontSize: '24px', color: '#fff' }).setOrigin(0.5);
    this.input.keyboard.once('keydown-SPACE', () => this.scene.start('Game', { level: 0, total: 0 }));
  }
}

new Phaser.Game({
  type: Phaser.AUTO, width: 800, height: 600,
  physics: { default: 'arcade', arcade: { gravity: { y: 1300 }, debug: false } },
  scene: [GameScene, WinScene],
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

I wrote the game as a single file, `~/work/v1/index.html`. I haven't opened it in a browser, so it is untested.

To play it, open the file in a browser. Phaser loads from a CDN, so you need an internet connection. Or run `python3 -m http.server` in that folder.

- **Controls:** Arrows or A/D move, and Up, W or Space jump. Press jump again in mid-air for the double jump.
- **Coins:** each one you pick up adds to the running total in the HUD.
- **Enemy:** each level has one red enemy that patrols back and forth. Landing on it from above kills it and bounces you. Touching it any other way restarts the level.
- **Levels:** there are two. Level 2 has pits, and falling into one restarts the level. Reaching the green flag moves you to the next level.
